name: Driving School Operations
audience: independent driving schools and small instructor teams
topic: lesson handoffs and road-test readiness for driving schools

products.name: Instructor Lesson Handoff
products.product: A focused driving lesson progress handoff workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent driving schools and small instructor teams
products.problem: Student goals, prior practice, observed skills, agreed homework, and next-lesson focus live in individual instructor notes.
products.valueProposition: Turns driving lesson progress handoff into a visible operating queue so every lesson ends with a concise progress handoff that the next assigned instructor can use.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets driving lesson progress handoff software, driving lesson progress handoff tracker, driving lesson progress handoff template, and driving lesson progress handoff checklist searches.

products.name: Road-Test Readiness Board
products.product: A focused driving school road test readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent driving schools and small instructor teams
products.problem: Eligibility documents, required practice, instructor judgment, vehicle booking, pickup details, and appointment timing are checked in separate places.
products.valueProposition: Turns driving school road test readiness into a visible operating queue so every supported road test has its administrative, vehicle, scheduling, and instruction prerequisites confirmed.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets driving school road test readiness software, driving school road test readiness tracker, driving school road test readiness template, and driving school road test readiness checklist searches.
